feature: Fix context bundle: inject file_histories + author_stats + per_stage metadata
problem: LLM context is missing file_histories and author_stats, limiting STAGE 3 evidence grounding. report.metadata has no per-stage token/cost/latency tracking.
proposed_solution: Inject file_histories as ## File History section in _build_initial_messages(). Inject author_stats as ## Author Stats. Fall back to missing_reasons[] when data unavailable. Add per_stage list to metadata with {stage, tier, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, cost_usd} from TurnCheckpoint data.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: _build_initial_messages() injects file_histories as '## File History' section when context.file_histories is non-empty; otherwise adds 'File history unavailable' to missing_reasons
AC-2: _build_initial_messages() injects author_stats as '## Author Stats' section when context.author_stats is not None; otherwise adds 'Author statistics unavailable' to missing_reasons
AC-3: report.metadata has per_stage list with at least one entry containing {stage, tier, tokens_used, cost_usd, latency_ms} per investigation turn
AC-4: Integration test verifies that mock context with file_histories produces '## File History' in the assembled user message
AC-5: D6 >= 0.70 on existing 12-commit panel reports (automated, no LLM calls)
edge_cases: EC-1: Empty file_histories dict {} must NOT add ## File History section and MUST add to missing_reasons
EC-2: file_histories with only empty lists per file (no history entries) must be treated as unavailable
verification_method: pytest tests/test_bundle_inject.py -v (AC-1,2,3,4); pytest tests/test_panel_script_gate.py -k d6 -v (AC-5); grep -n 'File History' src/commit_investigator/orchestrator.py (expect >=1 hit)
